column3: SQL trace flag off or sql-trace panel off gives SqlCapture DISABLED, as BootUI's recorder.isEnabled() = sqlTrace.isEnabled() && isPanelEnabled(SQL_TRACE) (BootUiAutoConfiguration.java:803; SqlCapture.java:60-66, v2.3.0): a check that needs SQL is UNAVAILABLE with the DISABLED reason, an optional read gets the caveat.
Proposed deviation (default taken, owner may reverse): with the flag on and the panel off, the DISABLED text still names SHARPIT_SQL_TRACE_ENABLED=false, the same wording BootUI uses for both causes.

Not ported here: BootUI's NOT_RECORDED (no wrapped DataSource) and R2DBC states. A default install with no SQLAlchemy engine, or with the SQL hooks suspended, still evaluates SQL checks clean, as on release. Follow-up lane: briefs task-W5c-sql-recorded-fact.md.
